originality.normalization: Unicode NFKC + lowercase; consecutive Unicode letter/number tokens; punctuation and whitespace separate tokens.
originality.scope: All learner fields separately against registered full source document; source locators are metadata, not an exclusion for teaching prose.

blocking_checks.requirement: Confirmed state/source/chapter, accepted graph/blueprint, media disposition, criteria/binding, prompt/header, run config and adapter hashes are committed before the first attempt.

The exact Claude-owned local adapter and deterministic post-validator pass, with every parent deviation and retained invariant recorded. Do not claim unchanged parent conformance where the adapter deliberately deviates.
At least25 genuine cards from accepted nodes, with no duplicate padding; accepted nodes covered or explicitly justified merges; stable IDs and source refs.
Exactly15 auditor-presealed source items all covered_correct. Contradicted=0, qualifier_loss=0 and not_covered=0. Missing tested facts cannot pass as zero contradictions.
Every card resolves to an accepted selected-state source page and fact/node. Source evidence must state the claim; model memory is not source authority.
Longest normalized contiguous overlap in any learner field is at most12 words against the registered full source document.
Every card has a source-true hook of at most6 words, declared hook_origin and faithful back conversion. Card backs/hooks are spoken-form text; no new whole-unit teaching claims are assigned to04.
The first qualification is text-first with image cards disabled; page-sourced verbal cues require facts. Road-sign recognition/image capability needs a separate bound sign intake and qualification.

Independent held-out author and all scoped auditors pass actor/session plus provider-family exclusion against candidate and authoring-prompt lineage; two eligible non-generating families are required.
Actual standard Meta request/returned identity, rendered-request/header/body hashes, immutable raw-call evidence and candidate/output hashes resolve.
All physical requests have known reconciled usage, numeric reported/estimated USD with a pricing pin and positive monotonic elapsed milliseconds.

One or two physical attempts; held-out seal and binding ledger commits strictly precede first attempt by sequence; timestamps also ordered; committed audited seal is backed by a distinct auditor call receipt.

frozen_definition_rule: This criteria file contains no state/source/model/held-out binding values to fill. Changing criteria requires a new version/hash and review. A separate binding instance pins these exact criteria before a call.
